overview_description.description:
Fliptango is a community market place platform that connects the user with the community who share similar lifestyle choices.

In the marketplace, users can buy, sell, bid, swap, share, or rent products and services with the community. It also helps with finding a job, bringing services for home, take care of refurbishing, moving, warehousing, among others, all within the preferred budget.

Renish Thomas developed the platform in Dubai, Dubai in 2015.
